title: Show HN: PharmA2A, an open protocol for pharmacy-to-supplier orders on A2A
summary:
I'm a pharmacist in France and a nerd. I built an open source protocol based on A2A, Called PharmA2A. Why, because normally I order directly from more than hundred of suppliers, by phone mails or on the web forms. 
The idea is to automatise orders of selling and buying between pharmacies and their suppliers. 
Since 12 November, PharmA2A is live on GH. 
Is anyone of you is using A2A in real life ?

title: Show HN: RealtimeVAD – trading false positives for 110ms earlier end-of-speech
summary:
Hey guys. I recently watched the latency reports for my local voice assistant, which show a waveform plus silero probability for voice activity. I noticed silero lags visibly on the speech off signal. There had to be a method to get this signal closer to what I felt is optimal. My idea was to use a 10 ms energy detector with a threshold that adapts to environment or room noise. Which worked amazingly well. It created more false positives but in my speculative generation pipeline that would not matter. If it's wrong and the user continues speaking I can abort the pipeline fast. I benchmarked my solution over ~3200 turns from my assistant logs and it came out ~110 ms faster initially. Still 100 ms now after some a fix which was needed for quiet speech. I made it public if you want to have a look. If you measure it on your data I really appreciate any feedback. There's a benchmark script in the repo. Thx for reading, have a good day folks.
